data.body: Live incident REPAIRED with the existing door the plan-review pointed to (ADR-0035): `rebar fsck --repair-snapshots` rebuilt the SNAPSHOT for e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2 (FIXED: 1 finding resolved), fsck back to baseline 8, and the bridge comment 48c15795 is restored to visibility. The plan as written was premise-refuted (proposed re-implementing rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log + ignored fsck_repair.py's AUTO_RECOVER/HUMAN_TRIAGE routing). Investigation under way to identify the REAL residual gap (doctor --repair routing? auto-heal on the writer path after union merge? proactive absorption at next fold?) — ticket will be rewritten to that gap or closed as duplicate.
